name: Nubia
uniques: Receive triple Gold from Barbarian encampments and pillaging Cities
startIntroPart1: Mighty Taharqa, King of Kush, ruler of the Black Pharaohs! Your ancestors conquered Egypt itself and ruled as pharaohs of the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty, uniting the Nile from Meroe to the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: The archers of Nubia are feared across the desert, and your smiths forge iron before any of your neighbors. Rebuild the Land of the Bow and let Meroe rise again!
declaringWar: Our arrows will darken your sky before our warriors ever reach your walls.
attacked: You have loosed the lion of the Nile. Now face its bow.
defeated: Kerma falls silent... but the river remembers.
introduction: I am Taharqa, King of Kush and Pharaoh of the Two Lands. Speak your business.
neutralHello: The Nile flows long. What do you seek?
hateHello: Choose your next words carefully, stranger.
tradeRequest: Gold for gold, iron for grain - a fair trade for both our peoples.

name: Gauls
uniques: [+15]% Strength for units fighting in [Friendly Land]
Gain [50] Influence with a [City-State] every time you fight a [Barbarian]
startIntroPart1: Vercingetorix, chieftain of the Arverni, greets you! Your tribes have long roamed the forests and rivers between the Rhine and the great western ocean.
startIntroPart2: Though Rome once forced its yoke upon your people at Alesia, the spirit of the Gauls was never broken. Unite the tribes and let Gaul stand free once more!
declaringWar: Our chariots will trample your fields before the next moon.
attacked: You wake a people who broke bread with wolves. This was unwise.
defeated: Alesia has fallen once before. It will not be forgotten.
introduction: I am Vercingetorix, chosen chieftain of a free people. Speak plainly.
neutralHello: The forests are watching. State your purpose.
hateHello: You test my patience, and my patience is short.
tradeRequest: Iron, wine, or grain - name it and we shall see if it is fair.

name: Phoenicia
startIntroPart1: Hail Hiram, King of Tyre! From your narrow strip of coast, your ships carried purple dye, cedar wood, and the alphabet itself to every shore of the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: No sea was too distant for a Phoenician keel, no market too far for a Phoenician trader. Set sail once more and let your colonies span the world!
declaringWar: Our fleets have already blockaded your harbors. Surrender now.
attacked: You have angered the masters of the sea. Every port will turn against you.
defeated: Tyre's walls have broken, but our ships have already sailed beyond your reach.
introduction: I am Hiram, King of Tyre. Let us speak of trade, not war.
neutralHello: The tides bring many visitors. What brings you?
hateHello: Our patience, like our purple dye, is rare and nearly spent.
tradeRequest: A fair exchange benefits every port it touches.

name: Sumer
startIntroPart1: Gilgamesh, King of Uruk, two-thirds god and one-third man! Between the Tigris and Euphrates, your people invented writing, the wheel, and the first codes of law.
startIntroPart2: Every city that has ever risen owes a debt to Sumer. Build the ziggurats anew and let the cradle of civilization bear its final fruit!
declaringWar: The tablets have already recorded your defeat.
attacked: Even Humbaba feared to challenge Uruk. You will learn why.
defeated: Uruk's walls, built by my own hands, could not hold forever.
introduction: I am Gilgamesh, King of Uruk. Wisdom favors those who listen.
neutralHello: The reeds along the river whisper of visitors. Speak.
hateHello: Enkidu is no longer here to restrain my temper.
tradeRequest: Barley for bronze - a bargain older than memory.

name: Numidia
uniques: [-33]% maintenance costs for buildings [in this city]
startIntroPart1: Masinissa, King of the Numidians, master of the finest horsemen in the ancient world! Your cavalry decided the fate of empires, riding without saddle or bridle across the plains of North Africa.
startIntroPart2: Once courted by Carthage and Rome alike, your people know the price of divided loyalty. Unite the tribes of the Atlas and ride to glory on your own terms!
declaringWar: Our horsemen are already circling your borders.
attacked: You have chosen to fight the finest riders beneath the sun. A grave error.
defeated: Even the swiftest horse cannot outrun every empire.
introduction: I am Masinissa, King of Numidia. Ride with me, or stand aside.
neutralHello: The Atlas foothills welcome few strangers. What do you want?
hateHello: My cavalry grows restless. Speak quickly.
tradeRequest: Horses for grain, friend - both our peoples profit.

name: Armenia
uniques: [+1] Happiness from each type of luxury resource
[-25]% Culture cost of natural border growth [in this city]
startIntroPart1: Tigranes the Great, King of Kings, ruler of Armenia! From your highland fortresses between three seas, your empire once stretched from the Caspian to the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: The mountains have sheltered your people through every storm of history. Raise the highland kingdom again and let it stand eternal among the peaks!
declaringWar: The mountain passes are ours. You will not cross them unchallenged.
attacked: You march against the roof of the world. Few who try succeed.
defeated: Even the highest peak erodes given enough time.
introduction: I am Tigranes, King of Kings. The mountains grant you an audience.
neutralHello: The highlands are quiet today. What brings you here?
hateHello: The passes can close as easily as they opened.
tradeRequest: A trade agreement as solid as our mountain fortresses.

name: Georgia
startIntroPart1: Queen Tamar the Great, sovereign of Georgia! Under your reign, your kingdom reached its golden age, stretching from the Black Sea to the shores of the Caspian.
startIntroPart2: Poets, builders, and warriors all flourished under your crown at the crossroads of Europe and Asia. Bring back the golden age and let Georgia shine once more!
declaringWar: The lion of Georgia does not warn twice.
attacked: You have chosen war with a golden age. Prepare for winter.
defeated: Our mountains held for centuries. Today, they did not hold.
introduction: I am Tamar, King of Kings and Queen of Queens of Georgia. Welcome.
neutralHello: The Caucasus greets travelers cautiously. Speak your purpose.
hateHello: My patience is a mountain pass - narrow, and easily closed.
tradeRequest: Silk and wine for what you offer - shall we agree?

name: Bulgaria
startIntroPart1: Khan Asparuh, founder of the first Bulgarian state! Crossing the Danube, your horsemen carved a lasting kingdom from the frontier of two crumbling empires.
startIntroPart2: For centuries your khanate stood as a bridge and a battleground between East and West. Cross the river once more and found a realm that endures!
declaringWar: The Danube has already carried word of your doom.
attacked: We crossed a mighty river to build our home. We will not be moved.
defeated: Pliska burns, but the khanate's memory does not.
introduction: I am Asparuh, Khan of the Bulgarians. Speak, traveler.
neutralHello: The steppe winds bring news of you. What is your business?
hateHello: My riders grow impatient at your delay.
tradeRequest: Grain and horses - a fair exchange between neighbors.

name: Hungary
uniques: Units gain [50]% more Experience from combat
startIntroPart1: King Matthias Corvinus, the Just, ruler of Hungary! Your legendary Black Army made your small kingdom one of the most feared powers in Central Europe.
startIntroPart2: From the Carpathian basin, your court became a beacon of Renaissance learning while your soldiers guarded the gates of Christendom. Rebuild the black army and let Hungary rise again!
declaringWar: The Black Army marches, and it does not retreat.
attacked: You have drawn the sword against the Just King. That was your last mistake.
defeated: Buda's library may burn, but Hungarian steel remembers.
introduction: I am Matthias Corvinus, King of Hungary. State your business, and be just about it.
neutralHello: The Danube plain welcomes cautious travelers. What do you seek?
hateHello: My mercenaries are paid whether they fight or wait. Choose quickly.
tradeRequest: A just trade, as befits a just king.

name: Zulu
uniques: Land units cost only 1 movement to disembark
startIntroPart1: Shaka, King of the Zulu, forger of the mighty impi regiments! You reshaped the art of war across southern Africa, discarding the throwing spear for the short iklwa and the deadly discipline of the buffalo horn formation.
startIntroPart2: In little more than a decade you built a nation from a small clan through sheer force of will and tactical genius. Raise the impi once more and let the horns of the buffalo encircle the world!
declaringWar: The horns of the buffalo are closing around you already.
attacked: You have chosen to fight the architect of the impi. Few survive that choice.
defeated: The horns have been cut, but the buffalo will calve again.
introduction: I am Shaka, King of the Zulu nation. Speak with respect, or not at all.
neutralHello: The plains are ours to watch. What is your purpose here?
hateHello: My impi await only my word.
tradeRequest: Cattle for cattle, or something of equal worth - shall we agree?
